task: Sum the first 5 prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, 11) and store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned `fold-left` processes the list in reverse order, so the accumulator starts with the last element.

nodes.out: ERROR: (set! answer ...) is INVISIBLE to the world — plain env vars vanish outside your expression; the checker reads the world key, not your local. Store the result with (rlm-set answer <value>)
